description: This file contains functions for rendering a 3D plane in OpenGL, specifically rendering the edges and faces of a plane using OpenGL primitives.

methods.name: void lu5_render_plane_edges(lua_Number half_x,lua_Number half_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the edges of a plane at specified half extents with a specified color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_plane_faces(lua_Number half_x,lua_Number half_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the filled faces of a plane at specified half extents with a specified color.
